content: Today was a good day. I started off with a refreshing hike at Eno River State Park, which always puts me in a good mood. It was nice to get some fresh air and exercise before heading back to campus. Then, I spent some time playing video games at my apartment, which helped me destress and unwind after a long week of classes and basketball practice. Overall, I feel satisfied and ready to rest up for the week ahead. I'm grateful for the balance I have in my life between my studies, basketball, and personal hobbies. It's important to take time for myself and recharge, and today was a perfect example of that.
